title: Statistics and Data Science
sourceText:
Completion Requirements

To be eligible for graduation with the bachelor of sciences degree, each student enrolled in the program must complete the following program requirements:

• Complete all general education requirements not met with transfer courses. See advisor for details.

• Complete a minimum of 45 credits of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences course work. Some majors or concentrations may require more.

• Complete a minimum of 45 credits of upper-division course work, including transfer courses and UW Tacoma courses.

• Complete the requirements for a major or concentration (minors are optional).

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA across all TSTAT courses.

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA across all courses applied to the major requirements

•

• Overview of Requirements

• Preparatory Coursework: 28-35 credits

• Core Courses in Statistics and Data Science: 30 credits

• Statistics and Data Science Electives: 15-16 credits; see Statistics and Data Science web page for approved list

• Capstone in Statistics and Data Science: 11 credits

• Ethics Course: 5 credits; Choose one course from the Ethics list; see Statistics and Data Science web page for approved list.

• Foundational Applied Course: 5-6 credits; Choose one course from the Foundational Applied list; see Statistics and Data Science web page for approved list

• TMATH 390 (5 credits) or TMATH 110 & TMATH 210 (10 credits) minimum 2.0 grade

• TMATH 124 minimum 2.0 grade

• TMATH 125 minimum 2.0 grade

• TMATH 126 minimum 2.0 grade

• TMATH 224 or MATH 224 minimum 2.0 grade

• TMATH 208 or MATH 208 minimum 2.0 grade

• TSTAT 280 minimum 2.0 grade

• TSTAT 345 minimum 2.0 grade

• TSTAT 346 minimum 2.0 grade

• TSTAT 336

• TSTAT 430

• TSTAT 422

• TSTAT 380 minimum 2.0 grade

• Capstone see Statistics and Data Science web page for approved list of capstone courses: Minimum 3 credits

• TSTAT 450

• Ethics: 5 credits

• Choose one course from the Ethics list; see Statistics and Data Science web page for approved list.

• Foundational Applied: 5-6 credits

• Choose one course from the Foundational Applied list; see Statistics and Data Science web page for approved list.

• Statistics and Data Science Electives: 15-16 credits

• See Statistics and Data Science web page for approved list
